# C# Mistakes Explained

Small, runnable C# mistakes - each exhibit is a bug you can run, its mirror fix,
and the mechanic behind it.

<!-- EXHIBITS:START (generated by tools/gen-frontpage.cs - do not edit below) -->

> **54** exhibits in **22** halls, latest - **#0054**.

### 🗂 Collections

- [0001](src/collections/0001-modify-while-enumerating/) never modify a **collection** while **iterating** it
- [0004](src/collections/0004-dictionary-key-mutation/) never mutate an object that serves as a **dictionary key**
- [0030](src/collections/0030-array-covariance-betrayal/) never write through a **covariant array** reference (@tygronia)

### 🔢 Numbers

- [0002](src/numbers/0002-doubles-for-money/) never use `double` for **money**
- [0025](src/numbers/0025-math-round-banker/) never assume `Math.Round` rounds **half up**
- [0029](src/numbers/0029-nan-poisons-comparison/) never divide by a value that can be **zero**
- [0050](src/numbers/0050-the-widening-that-came-too-late/) never trust a **wide** target type to fix `int` math - cast one operand first (@palkotnyk)

### ⚡ Async & Threading

- [0003](src/async/0003-race-on-shared-counter/) never mutate **shared state** without **synchronization**
- [0007](src/async/0007-async-void/) never write `async void` outside **event handlers**
- [0016](src/async/0016-token-tourism/) never accept a **token** you don't **pass down or check**
- [0018](src/async/0018-tasks-are-not-results/) never mistake a collection of **tasks** for a collection of **results**
- [0019](src/async/0019-forgotten-task/) never **drop a Task** - await it or hand it to someone who will
- [0021](src/async/0021-whenall-hides-exceptions/) never trust `await Task.WhenAll` to report **more than one failure**
- [0031](src/async/0031-parallel-foreach-swallows-async/) never hand an **async** lambda to `Parallel.ForEach` (@palkotnyk)
- [0035](src/async/0035-the-pool-that-ate-itself/) never block on **async** code with `.Result` or `.Wait()`
- [0036](src/async/0036-the-eliminated-await/) never elide `await` inside a **using** or try/finally block
- [0037](src/async/0037-the-double-wrapped-task/) never launch an **async** lambda with `Task.Factory.StartNew` - use `Task.Run`

### 🔗 LINQ & Lambdas

- [0006](src/linq/0006-closure-over-loop-variable/) never close over a **loop variable** - capture a copy
- [0009](src/linq/0009-multiple-enumeration/) never enumerate a **LINQ query twice** - materialize it once
- [0013](src/linq/0013-distinct-that-didnt/) never dedupe objects that don't define **equality**

### 🔔 Events

- [0010](src/events/0010-immortal-subscriber/) never subscribe to a **long-lived event** without **unsubscribing**
- [0023](src/events/0023-unremovable-lambda/) never **unsubscribe with a lambda** - name the handler
- [0052](src/events/0052-one-handler-kills-the-rest/) never raise an event unguarded - one throwing handler aborts the whole **invocation list**

### 📦 Value Types

- [0011](src/value-types/0011-defensive-copy-ambush/) never write a **mutable struct**
- [0054](src/value-types/0054-new-guid-is-empty/) never call `new Guid()` for a fresh id - it is **Guid.Empty**; use `Guid.NewGuid()`

### 💥 Exceptions

- [0005](src/exceptions/0005-throw-ex-stack-amnesia/) never rethrow with `throw ex` - use bare `throw`
- [0015](src/exceptions/0015-cancellation-eaten-by-catch/) never let a **catch-all** eat `OperationCanceledException`
- [0017](src/exceptions/0017-finally-that-lied/) never let a `finally` block **throw**

### 🗄 ORM

- [0008](src/orm/0008-n-plus-one/) never query the **database** inside a **loop**

### 📄 Serialization

- [0012](src/serialization/0012-zero-priced-order/) never deserialize without pinning the **naming contract**
- [0024](src/serialization/0024-polymorphic-loses-derived/) never serialize a **polymorphic** value without **declaring the hierarchy**

### 💉 DI Lifetimes

- [0014](src/di-lifetimes/0014-container-hoarder/) never resolve **transient disposables** from the **root container**
- [0022](src/di-lifetimes/0022-the-captive-scoped/) never inject a **scoped** service into a **singleton**

### 📅 Datetime

- [0020](src/datetime/0020-shrinking-billing-day/) never compute the next date from the previous one - keep the **anchor**

### 🗑️ Disposal

- [0026](src/disposal/0026-dispose-what-you-dont-own/) never dispose what you didn't **create**
- [0053](src/disposal/0053-the-wrapper-that-stole-the-stream/) never let a **wrapper** own a stream you still need - pass `leaveOpen: true`

### ⚖️ Equality

- [0027](src/equality/0027-null-comparisons-are-always-false/) never assume `>` and `<=` together cover a **nullable** value

### 📇 Records

- [0028](src/records/0028-with-copies-the-reference/) never put a **mutable collection** in a record
- [0049](src/records/0049-record-tostring-leaks-secrets/) never put a **secret** in a record - its `ToString` prints every member (@palkotnyk)

### 🧩 Pattern Matching

- [0033](src/pattern-matching/0033-switch-expression-not-exhaustive/) never trust a **switch expression** to be exhaustive just because it once compiled clean
- [0051](src/pattern-matching/0051-the-banned-user-walked-in/) never test a **[Flags]** enum with `is` - a constant pattern is exact equality, not `HasFlag` (@palkotnyk)

### 🪵 Logging

- [0032](src/logging/0032-interpolated-log-loses-everything/) never log a bare **string** - pass a template so every value becomes a named field (@helga-pawlowska)

### 🪆 Inheritance

- [0034](src/inheritance/0034-virtual-call-in-constructor/) never call a **virtual method** from a constructor - the override runs before its own fields are set (@alejandro-capel)

### 💾 Memory

- [0038](src/memory/0038-the-closure-that-held-everything/) never let a long-lived **closure** share a scope with a large object
- [0039](src/memory/0039-the-stack-that-only-grows/) never `stackalloc` inside a **loop**
- [0040](src/memory/0040-the-span-left-behind/) never keep a `Span` over a **List** that can still grow

### 🥊 Boxing

- [0041](src/boxing/0041-unbox-must-match-exact-type/) never unbox to anything but the **exact** boxed type
- [0042](src/boxing/0042-boxed-values-are-equal-not-same/) never compare **boxed** values with `==`
- [0043](src/boxing/0043-nullable-boxes-to-nothing/) never expect a boxed **nullable** to still be nullable

### 🧬 Generics

- [0044](src/generics/0044-variance-skips-value-types/) never expect `IEnumerable<object>` to match a **value-type** list
- [0045](src/generics/0045-sort-compiles-for-anything/) never `OrderBy` a type with no **ordering** defined

### 🕳️ Nullability

- [0046](src/nullability/0046-null-forgiving-lies/) never silence a nullable warning with `!` - it checks **nothing** at runtime
- [0047](src/nullability/0047-the-smuggled-null/) never assume deserialization respects your **non-nullable** annotations

### 🧪 Testing

- [0048](src/testing/0048-collection-assert-is-ordered/) never assert collection equality with `Assert.Equal` when **order** is incidental
